title: Sunzi — The Art of War (English)
summary: A complete English translation of the Sunzi (The Art of War) in thirteen chapters, from Reckonings to The Use of Spies, with the seventeen surviving fragments and the dialogues with King Helü of Wu. A plain-text edition: the eleven old commentaries from Cao Cao onward are not included. Each chapter opens with a short note on what it does.
